text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay, the ocean~☆ The sparkling beach is so 
gorgeous, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It kinda feels... so luxurious, right?! 
Like, we're totally in Dubai☆ vibes!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Um, an explanation, please. Please give 
me an explanation first.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What about training? What about the 
schedule? Why is Falcon-san here?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Please... explain yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to relaxing, traveling is 
the only way! Somewhere upscale like 
Dubai, maybe~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking Smart Falcon's suggestion, Dubai 
was out of the question, so we planned a 
trip to a domestic beach instead—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco brought Flash-san all the way here 
with her umadol power☆♪"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Umadol power? Are you referring to that 
brute arm strength?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's put that aside! We came all 
the way here, so let's have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Should I sip on a cute drink~, or chill 
on the beach~? Ah, sunburns are a no-go 
for an Umadol though—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for being so considerate. 
I'm truly happy for your thoughtfulness."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However... right now, I have no time to 
fool around. I must return to training—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I won't let you go home.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because Flash-san has been in pain for so 
long recently.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
She always used to come back at the same 
time, but lately it's been all over the 
place... Even back in our room, she looked 
exhausted right up until she went to bed.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I felt like... you weren't able to do 
things the way you wanted to, Flash-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco always just does whatever she loves 
and gets cheered on for it, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco wondered... if there really wasn't 
anything I could do for Flash-san."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—But, that definitely won't happen! 
Because Falco is an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
An umadol can make even gloomy folks 
smile☆ So if you hang out with Falco, 
you'll cheer right up, Flash-san!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
... That is quite an astonishing line of 
logic.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's true, you know☆ So forget 
about everything for today! Let's go have 
a blast with Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I walk around, I'm bound to find 
something! Guess I'll just wander—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Just wing it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides relaxing on the beach, please 
tell me what else you'd like to do."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll research the nearby spots and come up 
with a flawless plan.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Flash-san...! Yep, I'll leave it to you☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, through a series of events, our 
relaxing getaway had begun.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Waah~! The church is so big.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they're exhibiting historic 
stained glass. Would you like to go see 
it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of course! ...Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...? Why are you laughing?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd finally found something you 
like, Flash-san☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Does that make you happy? You truly are 
an unusual person.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And just as Eishin Flash began to relax—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Haaah... ugh...~... I ate way too much... 
My heartburn is killing me~...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is why I told you not to add extra 
cream...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. Flash-san, you *love* sweet things 
too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I do like it. Which is precisely why I 
adjust it so I can savor it to the 
absolute fullest.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you actually want to put a 
wholeee lot on, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I got terrible heartburn from doing 
that in the past. So I won't be doing it 
again."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Flash-san really is amazing, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco always adds so much whipped cream 
it buries the pancakes, and then regrets 
it every time."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I space out staring at my phone too much 
and oversleep. I get failing marks and 
can't finish my homework. I know better, 
but I keep messing up... Tee-hee.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Though Flash-san is different, right? You 
set goals, make a schedule, and steadily 
work toward them.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget my failures. Instead 
of going back and forth, I'm moving 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"So just go ahead and do whatever you 
want♪ If it's you, Flash-san, you can do 
anything!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
'Whether or not you can maintain your 
pride as an Uma Musume'―― In other words, 
the top of the world, G1.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The adjusted schedule is the "best 
possible plan" we can come up with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash is wavering at Smart Falcon's 
straightforward words. With the way she is 
right now—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list: How about a race with me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
âI've changed, but... are we really 
doing this?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I don't understand. There is no way a 
human could beat an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's sand, not turf... so you might have a 
shot! Do your best, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Alright then, take your marks—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the matter was settled in an 
instant.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Are you okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You're taking it too far. Now then, please 
tell me the reason.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Why would you propose such a ridiculous 
thing?
choice_data_list: We won, but you're not happy?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Of course. What's the fun in beating 
someone you know you can beat?"
choice_data_list: What you proposed means doing this.
This is what you were proposing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list:
There is no pride in a victory gained by 
running away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A perfect schedule—it is precisely because 
we reach for the ideal that victory holds 
meaning. Winning simply because you 'can 
win' is utterly meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be precise, it's meaningless *for her*. 
She has consistently put in the effort up 
until now. If that's the case, what she 
needs right now is--
choice_data_list:
Let's stay true to the race you truly want 
to run

Let's stay true to the race you yourself 
wish for.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Don't you want to win a G1, Flash?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I want to win. I want to run at the 
highest level... and win.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "I think that is... a noble deed as well."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However... is there any meaning in taking 
up a challenge when there's a chance of 
losing?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"If so, then is it so strange... to adjust 
my schedule so I can win before my 
parents' eyes?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash finally began to share her 
true feelings. I want to give a supportive 
push to her, who is so afraid of failure.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What happens after this run... is up to 
you, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then—
